image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a guenon monkey (likely a Blue Monkey or similar species) sitting in grass. The monkey has dark grey/black fur on its body and limbs, with a lighter grey/white chest and facial ruff. Its face is bare-skinned with a greenish-grey tint, forward-facing eyes, and a narrow nose. The background is a soft-focus green forest environment. There is faint text 'myrict' in the top left corner.

Eyes are forward-facing. Irises appear dark brown, consistent with the species.
The nose bridge is narrow and elongated, typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are small and partially hidden by the facial ruff, but visible and proportionate.
